rows.grounds: thousands; locative plural indicating location within
compound of womb and mechanism/device; locative plural indicating location within
afflicted or oppressed; past passive participle

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
items.inference: Existence within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms entails torment.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
